verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships first-party install guides for Docker Compose, which is the recommended path, and for Kubernetes via a Helm chart. It also documents npm and has a remote-deployment section with a hosting comparison table, detailed guides, and one-click Railway/Zeabur buttons. One community user found the install easy. Missing for 10: an explicitly named small-VPS guide (the remote-deployment section only implies one), any Raspberry Pi/ARM deployment guide, and evidence that each guide is actively maintained.
